┌─ Help: The mouse and the sidebar ────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ The mouse                                                                    │
│   Click ground      walk there; the server plans the route, inside this zone │
│   Click mob, person select it and open its card; click again (or F to        │
│                     attack, G to talk) to act                                │
│   Click loot        pick up everything within reach                          │
│   Click a marker    walk to it (a scout point, a world event's mark)         │
│   Hover             its name beside the pointer: a mob, person, door,        │
│                     marker, or you                                           │
│   Alt, Ctrl+A       name everything on the map (Ctrl+A if your terminal      │
│                     sends no Alt with the mouse)                             │
│   Wheel, + -        zoom the map                                             │
│   Right-click, Esc  let go of the selection                                  │
│                                                                              │
│   A first click never attacks. M opens the large map: click a spot to walk   │
│   there, or move the cursor with the arrows and press Enter. Shift+click is  │
│   never used: terminals keep it for selecting text. Every mouse action has a │
│   key; the game is fully playable without a mouse.                           │
│                                                                              │
│ The character sidebar                                                        │
│ Page 3 of 10  Up, Down scroll  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
